name: Purujosa (Spain)
description: White field with a blue semicircle rising from the lower edge, charged at the upper hoist with a red shield bearing a yellow Chi-Rho.
history: Municipal flag of Purujosa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

shield bearing a yellow Chi-Rho at the upper hoist
